conventions.color: '#RRGGBB' or '#RRGGBBAA' sRGB. 'system' names a native color used at runtime; 'nativeAccent' derives Current text/fill from the resolved user accent with quantized OKLCH lightness and gamut-limited chroma. Hex values remain preview and test fallbacks. Warm retains its explicit variants; runtime derivation is not native-surface acceptance.
conventions.units: Lengths in points (pt). Durations in milliseconds. Angles in degrees unless the key says Rad.
conventions.curves: Cubic Bezier control points [x1, y1, x2, y2], identical to CSS cubic-bezier() and SwiftUI Animation.timingCurve(_:_:_:_:duration:).
conventions.springs: {durationMs, bounce} as in SwiftUI Spring(duration:bounce:); Core Animation reads mass/stiffness/damping from the same Spring value.
conventions.geometry: Avatar shapes are parametric definitions in a 100 x 100 view box (y grows downward). Generated paths are cached per shape and size.
conventions.budgets: Budget classes B0-B3 are defined under performance.budgetClasses.
conventions.reduceMotion: 'instant' = final state with no interpolation; 'fade:<ms>' = opacity crossfade only (no translate, scale, rotate, blur); 'static-pose' = avatar still pose plus its non-motion cue.

contrastCorrection.source: Memoshi P0-13 accessibility correction after the central canonical contrast check exposed failures against 03-design-system.md §4/§11. These are derived accessibility values, not competitor-token adoption or rendered/native reference-hardware proof.
contrastCorrection.method: Only failing foreground role/appearance values change. Opaque chromatic roles move the least distance along OKLCH lightness at constant hue/chroma; chroma decreases only as needed to fit sRGB. Source-over translucent roles instead use the smallest 8-bit alpha increase with unchanged RGB. Candidates are quantized to 8-bit sRGB before evaluating every intended pairing, including shared Current/Warm status roles.
contrastCorrection.marginUse: Changed values target the unchanged 4.5:1 text, 7:1 increased text or 3:1 strong-boundary threshold plus 0.02 after quantization. Existing passing foregrounds remain untouched.
contrastCorrection.preserved: All surfaces, accent/default/fill/selection/focus roles, status fills/onFill, avatar identities, layout numbers, motion numbers and contrast-pair thresholds are unchanged. Original affected foreground bytes are recorded in each role's $source.

changelog: 4.0.0-draft.1 (2026-10-20): rewrite for Draft 4. Semantic roles with light, dark and increased-contrast values; AA-checked text and status roles; Aiden-derived motion system; avatar shapes, palette and states; performance budgets.

4.0.0-draft.2 (2026-10-20): consistency review against 03-design-system.md and 02-experience.md. skeleton.pulse is B1 at 30 fps (TimelineView); title3 weight is semibold; the inspector overlay threshold follows the current pane widths; floatingCard, live.takeover and avatar md uses match 03 (no controls over live views).

4.0.0-draft.3 (2026-10-20): D43 Kuvo parity. Chrome values on surfaces shared with Kuvo (layout, size, spacing, density, colour, materials, type) are provisional until the clean-room parity spec (phase-0 P0-19) lands; each replaced token will record kuvo-parity in its $source.

4.0.0-draft.4 (2026-10-20): D43 sequencing. v1 builds Kuvo's look and motion, so the motion recipes are provisional on shared surfaces too. The Aiden-derived recipes, the avatarGrid layout and other Aiden- or Grok-derived values stay here as the design-pass reference (03 design-pass backlog). Budget scenario setups are now design-neutral; keys are unchanged.

4.0.0-draft.5 (2026-10-23): D91 supersedes the historical no-source/observer/legal-first reuse policy with source-informed P0-19 reference/reuse assessment and permitted personal/noncommercial source inspection/copying/adaptation under applicable terms, notices and provenance. No source imported or fork selected; unknown Kuvo/Draft 3 values remain provisional pending a named-revision or runtime check. D43's visual baseline remains until separately amended while docs/research/2026-10-23-design-direction-review.md reviews Viticci's references. Existing keys, numeric tokens, geometry, tabs, feature phases and contracting assumptions are unchanged.

4.0.0-draft.6 (2026-10-23): D92 amends D43 with one coherent Viticci-led Apple-native assistant family + Kuvo-informed workbench across Mac/iPhone/iPad, replacing blanket shared-surface pixel/behaviour parity and parity-spec precedence. P0-19 now plans docs/specs/design-reference.md; scenario-based native design review retains same-state evidence, accessibility, Reduce Motion and all numeric performance gates. Source matches are evidence, not automatic token adoption; unknown Draft 3 values remain provisional pending evidence and Memoshi adoption review. D93 removes mandatory designer allocation, hiring and payment dependencies: builder + coding agents implement, user reviews design, required QA remains and targeted outside help is optional for a concrete identified gap and separately chosen scope/cost. Token keys and numeric definitions, original avatar geometry, current layouts and all phase/drop stages stay unchanged. Historical entries are preserved; no source import, fork, new feature, date change or builder-day saving is selected.

4.0.0-draft.7 (2026-10-25): D94 selects the newer Viticci reference set for native preview review. Add four-appearance palettes.warm overrides plus surface.resource and text.onUserBubble roles; preserve prior color values as Current. Generate palette-aware AdaptiveColor values and native tint without copying third-party artwork or treating these original ivory/amber values as exact screenshot measurements. Both apps expose a persistent local palette comparison. The design reference records native smoke, contrast checks and the remaining runtime/device/performance limits; no gate or feature stage moves.

4.0.0-draft.8 (2026-11-02): P0-13 gallery and avatar prototype generation. The generator now also emits color.status, opacity, typography, motion durations/curves/springs/frame rates, the avatar geometry/palette/face/size/badge/state/overlay tokens and $meta.version. Structured fields make previously prose-only rules machine-readable without changing any existing value: avatar.colorRules.mutedNeutral (the stated light/dark neutral, reused for increased contrast), avatar.face.edge widths, avatar.sizes.*.loopFpsMax, avatar.states.*.stillPose, has_news apexEyePose/sparkleFadeMs/rateLimitMs and asleep wakeTransition.eyesOvershootScaleY. Muted avatar fills are derived at generation as mix(fill, mutedNeutral, opacity.mutedAvatar) in sRGB. layout.gallery adds builder-chosen provisional review metrics for the component gallery window. Every value stays provisional pending P0-19 evidence and Memoshi accessibility/performance review; no measured contrast, performance or native-review result is implied.

4.0.0-draft.9 (2026-11-04): P0-13 generates native motion/material/elevation bindings, performance budgets and the intended contrast-pair catalogue. Correct 26 failing foreground role/appearance values using the documented minimal hue-preserving lightness or alpha derivation and a quantized 0.02 ratio margin, without changing surfaces, identity colors, fills, thresholds or pairs. Extract existing native sheet, mobile-browser-review and device-pairing geometry into explicitly provisional semantic tokens without changing its values; QR paper remains explicitly white for machine readability. No native material/focus, performance, user-review or reference-hardware pass is implied.

4.0.0-draft.10 (2026-11-04): Generate the existing general icon inventory and sizes without treating custom/composed/deferred marks as SF Symbol names. Derive Current accent.text/fill at runtime from the resolved native accent and intended opaque surfaces; preserve fallback bytes, Warm variants, contrast thresholds and all existing numeric tokens. Cache by native appearance, contrast, accent and native surfaces. This is implementation, not user adoption or reference/physical accessibility qualification.

4.0.0-draft.11 (2026-11-13): D127. Correct the 48 avatar.colors.<id>.text role/appearance values with the $meta.contrastCorrection method (least OKLCH lightness change at constant hue, chroma reduced only to fit sRGB, 8-bit quantization) until each meets its declared 4.6:1, or 7:1 under increased contrast, plus the 0.02 margin on all eight opaque text surfaces in Current and Warm; original bytes are in each role's $source. The contrast catalogue now checks those 96 pairs and the pressed prominent control (accent.onFill over surface.hover on accent.fill). Fills, muted fills, surfaces, thresholds and every other token are unchanged.

tier.$rule: Color escalates only from T3 up. The tier label and glyph are always shown; color is never the only cue.

diff.$rule: +/- markers stay visible whenever Differentiate Without Color is on; increased contrast adds a 2 pt leading bar in the marker color.

syntax.$source: Aiden 0.36.1 renderer/styles.css syntax tokens (MIT), checked >= 4.8:1 on surface.well; increased-contrast values darkened/lightened to >= 7:1.

terminal.$rule: Chromatic ANSI colors reach >= 4.6:1 (normal) and >= 6:1 (bright) on light, >= 5:1 and >= 8:1 on dark. ANSI black (dark) and bright white (light) are background-adjacent by convention.

use: primary action inside a glass cluster

glass.$rule: Glass is for the functional layer only. Never on messages, Cards, chips, diffs, terminal, files, previews, settings content or avatars, and never over live VM or WebKit views (LiveView controls sit in the inspector header; a detached live window uses an opaque surface.raised capsule). No glass on glass; group nearby glass in one GlassEffectContainer. Under Reduce Motion, glassEffectID morphs become crossfades.

family.ui: system (SF Pro; optical sizes chosen by the system)

chrome.$source: Apple HIG macOS built-in text styles. Footnote and Caption (10 pt) are not used for functional text.

markdown.$source: Adapted from Aiden 0.36.1 markdown.tsx scale as recorded in parity-audit-design-motion.md P0-2 (MIT)

typography.numerals: monospacedDigit() for counts, costs, tokens, timers and diff stats
rules: Never below 11 pt for functional text
Truncate with a tooltip, never shrink
No faux bold or italics; use font weights

radius.$style: continuous corners everywhere; nested shapes use ConcentricRectangle / containerShape (macOS 26+) so inner radius = outer radius - inset

elevation.$conversion: SwiftUI shadow radius = CSS blur / 2 [INFERENCE: Core Animation convention; verify visually in Phase 0]. CSS negative spread is approximated by lowering opacity. 'hairline' is a 0.5 pt stroke (border.hairline), not a shadow.

e3.use: opaque floating surfaces in the content layer (popover fallback)

elevation.$source: Aiden 0.36.1 renderer/styles.css:104-140 elevation tokens (MIT). Glass surfaces use system shadows, not these.

icon.library: SF Symbols shipped with macOS 27 (all names below verified present in CoreGlyphs name_availability.plist on macOS 27.0.1)
rules: Filled variants only for selected or state badges
Every icon-only control has a tooltip (.help) and an accessibility label
No third-party icon sets; custom symbols drawn in the SF Symbols template

custom.bot.face: Memoshi template symbol: squircle with two pill eyes; used for the Bots section and the menu bar extra (drawn by us)

statusGlyph.working: activity mark quad-shuffle (static t=0 under Reduce Motion)

curves.$rule: Chrome uses only overshoot-free curves. 'turn' and springs with bounce > 0 are reserved for avatars and activity marks.

settle.use: layout settle after insert or resize

frameRate.transitions: native (up to 120 Hz); one-shot and input-driven
frameRate.$rule: Ambient loops set CAAnimation.preferredFrameRateRange or TimelineView minimumInterval; nothing ambient renders at 120 Hz.

reduceMotion.setting: Tri-state: System / On / Off (Settings > Accessibility). System follows accessibilityReduceMotion; live changes reconcile immediately to the final state.
reduceMotion.removes: translation, scale, rotation, blur, parallax, morphs, bounces, loops, staggered character reveals
reduceMotion.keeps: opacity crossfades up to 150 ms for elements that appear or disappear; functional meters; color changes
reduceMotion.streaming: reveal all units at once; handoff 0 ms

reveal.block.use: Atomic Markdown block appears (code fence, table, list, heading, quote)

reveal.handoff.use: Swap streaming view for persisted message
reveal.handoff.note: no interpolation; swap inside a transaction with animations disabled

reveal.blockGate.use: Fallback cadence: Low Power Mode, or backlog above 40 units

shimmer.sweep.use: ThinkingShimmer label while a model thinks or a tool runs

ticker.row.note: Aiden adds blur(2px); Memoshi drops blur (cost; upstream 0.58.0 also removed it)

ticker.shift.use: ActivityTicker: stack shifts up one row

title.reveal.use: Session title changes to a generated title (a bot's Chat keeps the bot's name)
title.reveal.note: Staggered per-character fade and rise; never simulated typing

chip.enter.use: ToolChip, TaskChip, SubagentChip, attachment chip appear
chip.enter.source: aiden-0.36.1 docs/chatgpt-desktop-ui-inspiration.md:216 (Aiden adaptation, no overshoot); aiden-0.58.0 styles.css:625-627

chip.state.note: symbol .replace uses system timing; label crossfade 200 ms standard

disclosure.toggle.use: Code Mode card, ToolGroup, reasoning disclosure expand/collapse

toolgroup.settle.use: Turn settles: ActivityTicker collapses into ToolGroup summary

composer.focus.use: Composer focus fill (about 2% deeper, no accent ring)

palette.enter.use: Slash/mention palette opens above the composer

floatingCard.enter.use: Anchored floating summary (Changes chip popover, footer popovers)

inbox.arrive.use: New needs-you item while the window is key
inbox.arrive.effect: symbolEffect(.bounce) once on the Inbox glyph

spinner.use: Indeterminate progress when no activity mark fits

skeleton.pulse.source: Tailwind animate-pulse as used by Aiden (parity audit 5.3)

pill.meter.reduceMotion: bars update at 10 Hz without interpolation (functional feedback)

quickAsk.expand.use: QuickAsk reply area expands in the MenuBarExtra panel
quickAsk.expand.note: Mirror of Aiden's bottom-anchored assistant dock for a top-anchored panel

modelPad.canvas.use: Model Pad canvas repositions when a side panel opens

live.takeover.note: 2 pt accent.default border fades in; in-control Banner

handoff.link.use: HandoffCard link from source to target avatar

budget.meter.thresholdCrossing: 200 ms color crossfade + one symbolEffect(.bounce) on the warning glyph at 80%

diff.hunkAccept.use: Accepted hunk collapses to an 'Accepted' stub

activityMark.use: Running indicator inside chips and rows (Aiden activity marks)

glance.meaning: waiting for approval or an answer

rules: Animate translation, rotation, scale and opacity only
Freeze on the t = 0 pose when inactive, off-screen, or under Reduce Motion; never hide a mark instead

avatar.$units: Keyframes are [t, value] with t in 0...1 of the period. Offsets are view-box units (percent of avatar size); rotation in degrees; scale unitless.

colorRules.eyeInkContrast: Eye ink on every fill >= 5.1:1 (light/dark), >= 6.7:1 (increased contrast)
colorRules.textVariant: Bot name text in the bot's color uses colors.<id>.text (>= 4.6:1; 7:1 increased contrast) on every opaque text surface (content, window, inspector, card, cardHover, well, resource, raised) in both palettes (D127). Fills are never used for text.
colorRules.muted: paused/offline fill = mix(fill, neutral, 0.65); neutral light #B8B8BC, dark #7C7C80

mutedNeutral.note: Structured copy of the muted rule's neutral. Increased contrast reuses the light/dark neutral; the mix fraction is opacity.mutedAvatar.

colorRules.cvdNote: Pairs in cvdConfusableWith have OKLab dE < 0.035 under Machado 2009 severity-1.0 simulation; the generator never gives two bots with the same shape a confusable pair.

sm.use: sidebar bot rows (two-line, with subtitle), session lead avatars, chips, Card headers

md.use: Assistant row, message headers, group member stacks, sidebar rail

positions.computerLevel: top-leading (>= 40 pt, only for Bot computer / Remote machine)

needs_you.label: Needs you: <first pending item> (+n)
needs_you.reduceMotion: static-pose: glow ring at full opacity + glyph + label

oneShot.name: cheer
oneShot.sparkle: sparkle glyph draws on at top-trailing, fades by 1200 ms

paused.label: Paused / Paused: a week without you / Paused: budget reached (pauseReason user | away | budget)

generation.storage: Bot.avatar = {shape, color} with the ids above; no uploaded images in v1
assignment: Never repeat an existing (shape, color) pair while fewer than 144 bots exist
Prefer an unused color, then an unused shape
Maximize the minimum OKLab distance to the roster under normal vision and under deuteranopia and protanopia simulation; avoid cvdConfusableWith pairs on the same shape
Assistant default: the palette color nearest the current accent, shape circle
generation.import: bot.md keeps its pair unless it collides; then keep the shape, reassign the color, and tell the user
generation.templates: Starter templates carry a recommended pair
generation.rendering: Paths generated from the parametric definition, cached per shape and point size, pixel-snapped at <= 20 pt; eyes are separate layers so poses animate independently

performance.display: ProMotion up to 120 Hz: 8.33 ms per frame; 60 Hz displays: 16.7 ms

budgetClasses.B0: No per-frame main-thread work: Core Animation render server or system-driven effects. <= 0.5 ms main thread at state change.
budgetClasses.B1: <= 0.5 ms main-thread time per frame while running
budgetClasses.B2: <= 1 ms main-thread time per frame while running
budgetClasses.B3: <= 2 ms main-thread time per frame while running (streaming text, title reveal)

P-IDLE.setup: window visible, nothing running, all avatars static

P-STREAM.setup: reply streaming 60-100 tokens/s (harness: 5,000 tokens at 60 tok/s) with 12 avatars visible

P-HIDDEN.setup: window occluded, minimized, app hidden or display asleep while bots run

performance.$source: 03-design-system.md#performance-budgets; MASTER_PLAN section 14 for launch and switch targets
